notes: “The wonderful Corinne there with a track called Riverboat and that's off an EP called Deluge”

rows.title: Little Demon (Arca Remix)
notes: “you hear the track Little Demon, the Arca remix featuring Skepta”
Frank Ocean & Skepta's Little Demon remixed by Arca, premiered on blonded RADIO in Nov 2019; no standard streaming release.

rows.title: The National Single
notes: “The Canberra duo Spartak there with a track called The National Single.”
Spartak is a real Canberra improvised/glitch duo, but the exact track title couldn't be confirmed in their listed discography.
“I'm going to play you another track from that compilation by Seaworthy... So this is Sayworthy on Slapless in Sydney”
Seaworthy (Cameron Webb) is a real Australian ambient/field-recording project with several compilation appearances; specific track not pinned down.

rows.title: A Ghost to Keep Us Safe, a Ghost to Keep Us Warm
notes: “A ghost to keep us safe, a ghost to keep us warm there by the Swedish artist by the name of Jasper TX, also on the 2008 compilation Tomorrow and Tomorrow and Tomorrow”
Jasper TX (Dag Rosenqvist, Sweden) appeared on the 2008 compilation Tomorrow & Tomorrow & Tomorrow Vol. 1 as stated.
“so we're going to hear from that release now uh it's playing underneath me”
Likely the harsh-noise-wall project I ♥ Black Bear (Anti-Music Noise Team), released on Skitnaste/Basement Corner Emissions; no title given.
“later we're going to play I'm going to play some Heil Spirits as well also on this kind of noise tip”
Real Melbourne noise/drone project by Eli Partridge on An Out Recordings; fits the 'noise tip' description.
“The Black Bear CD-R on Sound and Fury Records there.”
“i'm gonna bring it back to i think probably 2007 with this one die on planes uh some sludgy stuff from the 2000s”
Real Brisbane sludge/doom band, though their earliest traceable releases are from 2012-13, not 2007 as guessed.

rows.title: Bovine University
notes: “for now this is the Thor with Bovine University”
ASR mangled 'Ten Zen Men' as 'the Thor'; confirmed track on Bandcamp.

rows.title: Hometown
notes: “And before that was a track called Hometown.”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
“thanks boris for the chance to play this incredible clip again”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played

rows.title: Still Mine
notes: “there was a track called Still Mine”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
Likely a Frank Ocean loosie released via blonded Radio in Dec 2023, produced by SebastiAn and Vegyn.
